[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Marrix''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who, during one of his expeditions, made first contact with the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]]. Reportedly respected by the Gree, Marrix was allowed to visit their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] on one occasion.<ref name="The Gree Enclave">{{JournalCite|8|The Gree Enclave}}</ref>
